messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on angular velocity.
velocity is represented by omega.
omega determines the damping torque.
torque depends on a coefficient.
coefficient depends on geometry.
geometry affects the viscous force.
force also depends on viscosity.
viscosity varies with medium and temperature.
temperature changes air resistance.
resistance should be included when it is noticeable.
noticeable resistance changes amplitude and period.
period changes require a damped physical pendulum model.
model should be used for precise experiments or long swings.
swings in vacuum or very slow ones may omit it.
